newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ Deer Farms buys 7 S.Island farms for NZ$10 mln.
newsitem.headline: NZ Deer Farms buys 7 S.Island farms for NZ$10 mln.

text.p: New Zealand Deer Farms said on Thursday it had completed its private placement and confirmed the purchase of a further seven prime South Island farms.
The company says it is now the world's largest commercial deer farmer, with 10 South Island stations and farms covering 9,735 hectares.
"The placement, which was over-subscribed, enables NZDF to confirm the purchase of seven properties, one in North Otago and the rest in Southland, to a value of $10 million," the company said.

NZDF had earlier contemplated a full public issue to fund its expansion, but decided against such a course in February and instead raised new share capital through a placement of shares to a group of private investors.
On full production following conversion of the seven properties, NZDF expects to run approximately 50,000 head of deer, with the focus on intensive venison production.
